Rashi on Nedarim 22b:10:1.hebrew: כל שהיא תפארת לעושיה ותפארת לו מן האדם - שיהא דבר מקובל נמי בעיני הבריות, הוי תפארת לעושיה. והואיל דאיקפד רב נחמן, שאין מתקבל עליו שנדרו חמור כ"כ שאינו יכול למצוא לו פתח, אדעתא דהכי והכי לא נדרי:
Rashi on Nedarim 22b:10:1.english: Any [path] that is a glory to the one who does it and a glory to him from [his fellow] men - That it should be something acceptable also in the eyes of people, [that] is a glory to the one who does it. And since Rav Nachman became upset — that it is not acceptable to him that his vow is so severe that he cannot find an opening for it — with such-and-such in mind, I would not have vowed.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:1:1.hebrew: לא עברינן ירדנא - עדיין לא עברנו את הירדן כשאירע אותו מעשה, ולא הוינן בתחום א"י:
Rashi on Nedarim 22b:1:1.english: We had not crossed the Jordan - We had not yet crossed the Jordan when that incident occurred, and we were not within the territory of the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:2:1.english: In the height of his anger - [Meaning] that he has wrath.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:2:2.english: There is no God [in] all his thoughts - In his thoughts, the Divine Presence is not important to him.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:2:3.english: Unfolds folly - That he acts foolishly.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:2:4.english: Abounds in transgression - [Meaning] that his transgressions are numerous.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:3:1.hebrew: מפני שערכה של ארץ ישראל הוא - שכתוב בו ערך חלק של כל שבט ושבט, ולא סגיא בלאו הכי. ולפי שבעטו וחטאו, נוסף להם רוב חכמה — שאר הספרים — להטריחן יותר:
Rashi on Nedarim 22b:3:1.english: Because it is the arrangement of the Land of Israel - For the arrangement of the portion of each and every tribe is written in it, and it would not suffice without this. And because they rebelled and sinned, an abundance of wisdom — [namely,] the rest of the books [of Scripture] — was added for them, to burden them further.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:4:1.english: One does not attend - to dissolve his vow for him, because it is a stringent vow.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:4:2.hebrew: חוץ מקונם אשתי נהנית לי - שאפילו נדר באלהי ישראל שאין אשתי נהנית לי, נזקקין להתיר לו. לפי שאמרה תורה "שמי שנכתב בקדושה ימחה על המים" בידים לעשות שלום בין איש לאשתו, לא כ"ש האי נדר, אי נדר באלהי ישראל שהוא לשון נדר:
Rashi on Nedarim 22b:4:2.english: Except for "Konam [is] my wife benefiting from me" - For even if he vowed by the God of Israel that "my wife shall not benefit from me," we attend [to him] to dissolve [it] for him. Since the Torah said, "My Name, which was written in holiness, shall be erased upon the waters" deliberately to make peace between husband and wife, is it not all the more so [with] this vow, if he vowed by the God of Israel, which is an expression of a vow?

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:6:1.hebrew: לא מרי כולא - שהוא נשבע באדון העולם: "לא אוכל". א"ל רב יוסף: "לא מרי כולא, לא טעימת ליה". הכי קאמר רב יוסף: "לא מרי כולא" קאמרת, בודאי לא טעימת ליה, שאסור להתיר לך, דהיינו כמי שנשבע באלהי ישראל:
Rashi on Nedarim 22b:6:1.english: No, [by] the Master of all - For he is swearing by the Master of the Universe: "I will not eat." Rav Yosef said to him: "No, [by] the Master of all, you will not eat it." This is what Rav Yosef is saying: "[Since] you said, 'No, [by] the Master of all,' you will certainly not eat it, for it is forbidden to dissolve [the vow] for you, as this is like one who swore by the God of Israel."

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:6:2.english: [It is missing here, and I copied it from the commentary of Rabbeinu Gershom]

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:6:3.hebrew: הניחא לרב כהנא - לפי שהיה מסרב בו רב יוסף, נדר הכי. אלא רב יוסף, אמאי קאמר נמי לא מרי כולא:
Rashi on Nedarim 22b:6:3.english: [It is] well for Rav Kahana - Because Rav Yosef was pressing him, he vowed thus. But [as for] Rav Yosef, why did he also say, "No, [by] the Master of all"?

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:6:4.hebrew: [ה"ק לא מרי כולא קאמרת] - בתמיה, קא"ל רב יוסף, כדאמרן:
Rashi on Nedarim 22b:6:4.english: [This is what he said: "No, [by] the Master of all," is what you said] - In astonishment, Rav Yosef said to him, as we said [earlier].

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:9:1.english: Rav Nachman became upset - Because he was unable to say to him anything that would be an opening for regret.

Rashi on Nedarim 22b:9:2.hebrew: אמר ליה זיל לקילעך - לביתך, הואיל ואיני יודע לפתוח לך:
Rashi on Nedarim 22b:9:2.english: He said to him: Go to your tent - [Go] to your house, since I do not know [how] to find an opening for you.

Tosafot on Nedarim 22b:10:1.hebrew: לעושיה - להקב"ה; "ותפארת לו מן האדם" — שבני אדם מקלסים אותו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 22b:10:1.english: To its Maker - [meaning] to the Holy One, blessed be He; "and a glory to him from man" — [meaning] that people praise him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 22b:10:2.hebrew: והשתא דאיקפד רב נחמן אדעתא דהכי וכו' - פי': משום דליכא תפארת מן האדם, אבל תפארת לעושיה שמא הוה, כגון שנדר לקיים דבר מצוה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 22b:10:2.english: "And now that Rav Naḥman became upset, with knowledge of this, etc." - Explanation: Because there is no glory from people, whereas glory to the one who does it perhaps there was, such as when he vowed to fulfill a matter of mitzvah:

Tosafot on Nedarim 22b:10:3.hebrew: ושריא לנפשיה - פי': שע"י פתח זה נתחרט והפר לו נדרו. וא"ת: אמאי לא התיר לו רב נחמן מעיקרא ע"י חרטה, דהא רב נחמן גופיה אמר לעיל "הלכה פותחין בחרטה"? וי"ל: דהיינו דוקא כשמתחרט מן הנדר מעיקרא, אבל כשאינו מתחרט אלא מכאן ולהבא — לא; ולכך לא רצה להתירו עד שאמר "אדעתא דהכי נדרת":
Tosafot on Nedarim 22b:10:3.english: And he dissolved [the vow] for himself - Explanation: Through this opening, he regretted [having made it] and annulled his vow for himself. And if you ask: Why did Rav Naḥman not dissolve [it] for him at the outset through regret, since Rav Naḥman himself said earlier, "The halakha is that we open [a vow] with regret"? One can say: That is specifically when one regrets the vow from the outset, but when one only regrets [it] from now on — no; therefore, [Rav Naḥman] did not want to dissolve [it] for him until he said, "Did you vow with this in mind?":

Tosafot on Nedarim 22b:4:1.hebrew: אין נזקקין לאלהי ישראל - דכיון שנשבע בשם שמים, אין נזקקים לו: חוץ מקונם אשתי נהנית לי שגנבה את כיסי ושהכתה את בני ונודע לו שלא הכת' - וריצב"א ל"ג "ונודע לו שלא הכתה", דאם כן אפי' התרה נמי לא בעי, דאמר: כשם שנדרי שגגות מותרות כך שבועות שגגות מותרות. אלא הכי גרסינן: "חוץ מקונם אשתי נהנית לי" ותו לא. ומיירי שהוא אמת שגנבה כיסו ושהכתה את בנו, דהשתא בעי התרת חכם, וקאמר דאפי' נשבע באלהי ישראל, נזקקין להתירו משום שלום בית:
Tosafot on Nedarim 22b:4:1.english: "One does not attend to [a vow invoking] the God of Israel" - Because once he swore by the Name of Heaven, they do not attend to him [to dissolve it]. "Except for [a case of]: 'Benefiting from me is konam for my wife because she stole my purse or she hit my son,' and it became known to him that she did not hit [him]" - And Ritsba does not read [in the text]: "and it became known to him that she did not hit [him]," for if so, it would not even require dissolution [by a sage], as it states: Just as vows [made in] error are permitted, so too oaths [made in] error are permitted. Rather, this is how we read [the text]: "Except for: 'Benefiting from me is konam for my wife,'" and nothing more. And it is dealing with [a case] where it is true that she stole his purse and that she hit his son, so that now it requires dissolution by a sage; and [Rabbi Asi] is saying that even if he swore by the God of Israel, they attend [to it] to dissolve it for the sake of domestic peace.
